columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Transactional cancellation of unsettled agent runs when a conversation is deleted
columns.title_zh: 删除 Conversation 时事务化取消所有未结清 Agent Run
columns.source_zh: Langfuse 合并维护者实现变更
columns.reason: The signal exposes a bounded Digital Employee lifecycle mechanism: queued, approval-waiting and running work is cancelled under the same conversation-row lock used for admission, preventing deleted work contexts from leaving orphaned workers or occupied execution slots.
columns.reason_zh: 该信号给出了边界清晰的数字员工生命周期机制：Queued、Awaiting Approval 与 Running 工作在与 Admission 相同的 Conversation Row Lock 下统一取消，避免已删除工作上下文留下孤儿 Worker 或占用执行 Slot。
columns.next: Skill 03 may inspect only the cancellation transaction, lock/admission relationship, covered run states, orphan-prevention semantics and explicit limitations.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 仅核查取消事务、Lock 与 Admission 的关系、覆盖的 Run 状态、孤儿任务防护语义及明确限制。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Short-lived workload identity exchange with child-process credential boundary
columns.title_zh: 短期 Workload Identity Exchange 与子进程凭据边界
columns.source_zh: openai/codex 合并维护者实现变更
columns.reason: A concrete enterprise control-plane boundary is visible: file-backed workload identity is exchanged for short-lived credentials with caching and refresh, while launch-context identity is stripped from executions, MCP servers, hooks, Git and remote child processes.
columns.reason_zh: 该信号暴露了具体的企业控制面边界：文件型 Workload Identity 被交换为短期 Credential，并具备缓存与刷新；同时 Launch Context 身份从 Execution、MCP Server、Hook、Git 与远程子进程中移除。
columns.next: Skill 03 may inspect only identity exchange, refresh/coalescing, credential lifetime, child-process stripping and trust-boundary behavior.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 仅核查身份交换、刷新与请求合并、凭据生命周期、子进程剥离以及 Trust Boundary 行为。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Checkpoint conformance as a detector for persisted-state migration defects
columns.title_zh: 用 Checkpoint Conformance 捕获持久状态迁移缺陷
columns.source_zh: LangGraph 合并维护者实现变更
columns.reason: The signal is directly implementable and reproducible: enabling one shared conformance suite across SQLite and Postgres immediately exposed a previously skipped persisted delta-history migration defect, linking test-contract design to durable state correctness.
columns.reason_zh: 该信号可直接实现和复现：SQLite 与 Postgres 启用同一共享 Conformance Suite 后立即暴露此前被 Skip 的持久化 Delta History 迁移缺陷，把测试契约设计与持久状态正确性直接连接起来。
columns.next: Skill 03 may inspect only the conformance contract, migrated plain-value seed detection, backend parity, failure reproduction and remaining persistence boundaries.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 仅核查 Conformance Contract、迁移 Plain Value 的 Seed Detection、后端一致性、缺陷复现与剩余持久化边界。
